reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "CRDs installed separately: If CRDs are installed separately, the first step you need to do is bump the crds: Verify no error occurs", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Operators upgrading an environment whose CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
consequence.remediation: Run kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml, verify no error occurs, then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.

proposed.statement: Environments upgrading to external-secrets 0.16 where the CRDs are installed separately must first apply the v0.16.1 CRD bundle (kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/v0.16.1/deploy/crds/bundle.yaml), verify no error occurs, and only then migrate external-secrets to v0.16.1.
